readerCopy.body: A movement demanding open access may run directly into the institution that still owns the infrastructure underneath it. Uranus opposite Pluto can expose how far decentralization can go when another party controls the servers, money, licensing, data, or legal consequences required to keep the route open. Freedom at the user level can coexist with concentrated power underneath it. Name that dependency before calling the system decentralized. Check who can enter today and who still has the power to close the door tomorrow.
